title: Media Buy Submitted
description: An async task envelope for a media buy that is not yet confirmed. The media buy ID and packages arrive in the terminal result.

expected_confirmation_at.description: Optional estimate of when the seller expects to confirm this request, used when confirmation depends on a scheduled event such as a booking round or a manual review window. A seller SHOULD set it when it knows that event; omit it when it does not. Buyers SHOULD schedule a status check (get_task_status, or reconciling against the webhook) for this time rather than polling tightly before it. This is an estimate, not a commitment: the seller MAY confirm earlier or later, the task status remains authoritative, and buyers MUST NOT treat a passed timestamp as a failure or auto-cancel on it. Sellers SHOULD NOT send a timestamp in the past. Not an expiry or SLA.

errors.description: Optional advisory errors accompanying the submitted envelope. Use only for non-blocking warnings (e.g., throttled_severity advisories, governance observations). Terminal failures belong in the error branch, not here.

context.description: Opaque media-buy-level correlation data echoed unchanged from the create_media_buy request. Sellers MUST echo this object verbatim when the originating request carried context, including synchronous success, error, submitted, and webhook task-status payloads. Sellers MUST NOT parse this object for business logic.
